name: Metric Integrity and Result Reconciliation
recall_reconciliation: NOT_DIRECTLY_COMPARABLE. Historical 0.4805 was produced by benchmark runner with broken semantic API (query_text= kwarg rejected by FAISSSemanticIndex.search) making the semantic fallback contribute zero candidates. Gate 11 0.6307 is produced by API-corrected runner, but semantic fallback still contributes zero recall because calibrated threshold (0.80) is too high. Both results reflect graph-only execution in practice. The shift 0.4805->0.6307 reflects different ground-truth realization conditions from the same generator seed, not genuine algorithm improvement. 0.6307 is the authoritative current result (API-correct, seed=42, documented). 0.4805 is superseded.

safety_invariant.definition: T_safe SUBSET T_selected: For every mutation, all known mandatory safety tests are in selected_tests

safety_critical_recall.note: Also 1.0 because safety gate forces inclusion of all known mandatory tests. Historical 47.61% was from a run without safety gate enforcement.

architecture_b_integrity.required: strict set union of graph and semantic artifacts
architecture_b_integrity.implemented: weighted fusion (wg=0.55, ws=0.30, wc=0.15) with min_score_threshold=0.20
architecture_b_integrity.impact: dormant at threshold=0.80 (semantic=0), but blocks genuine hybrid evaluation

findings.title: configs/final.yaml not consumed by benchmark runner
findings.detail: configs/final.yaml uses threshold=0.45 and max_depth=3. benchmark/final/runner.py uses max_depth=5 (from its own config.py) and calibrates threshold to 0.80. The canonical config file exists but is not the runtime config for the benchmark.
findings.action_required: Gate 13: Align benchmark runner with configs/final.yaml OR create a documented benchmark-specific config that explicitly overrides the canonical values.

findings.title: ImpactFusionEngine uses weighted fusion, not strict set union (Architecture B violation)
findings.detail: Architecture B requires: S_final = S_struct UNION S_semantic (all artifacts from either source included). Implemented as: final_score = 0.55*g + 0.30*s + 0.15*c, then filtered by min_score_threshold=0.20. This can exclude structurally reachable nodes. Currently dormant (semantic=0 at threshold=0.80) but architecturally incorrect.
findings.action_required: Gate 13: Implement strict set union. Do NOT modify Architecture B. Do NOT optimize weights. Remove score-threshold exclusion from Architecture B output.

findings.title: AURA Hybrid recall == Graph_Only recall (semantic contributes zero)
findings.detail: Verified: 150/150 mutations have identical AURA and Graph recall (max diff = 0.0000). Calibrated semantic threshold 0.80 causes zero candidates to be retrieved. The benchmark does NOT currently evaluate a hybrid algorithm — it evaluates the graph algorithm twice.
findings.action_required: Gate 13: Set semantic threshold to configs/final.yaml canonical value (0.45), implement strict union, re-run benchmark. Verify that AURA recall > Graph_Only recall on semantic/hidden-semantic mutations.

findings.title: Historical 47.61% safety recall explained and resolved
findings.detail: The historical benchmark ran without the safety gate enforced. Gate 11 with enforcement shows 100%. BLOCKER-001 is resolved. The distinction between safety invariant (T_safe SUBSET T_selected) and discovery recall has been explicitly documented and tested.

next_gate.name: Architecture B Implementation and Genuine Hybrid Evaluation
prerequisites: Fix ImpactFusionEngine to implement strict set union (resolve F2)
Set semantic threshold to 0.45 from configs/final.yaml (resolve F3)
Re-run full benchmark and verify AURA recall > Graph_Only on semantic mutations
